Careers at MeebuHybrid · Lahore / Remote-friendly

Do the work you will remember.

Join a small team where your decisions reach the game, your questions are welcome, and your craft has room to grow.

Life at Meebu

4.5

Focused days per week
Friday afternoon = play

Great games need intensity. Great careers need space.

We plan around focused work, not performative hours. Core collaboration happens in a shared window; the rest of the day is yours to shape around deep work and real life.

Friday afternoons belong to playtests, show-and-tells, experiments, or learning something outside your lane. No slide decks. No status theatre. Just work in motion and honest feedback.

What we offer

Built for long creative lives.

Benefits designed around doing excellent work without burning out the person doing it.

01 / TIME

Flexible rhythm

Hybrid work, flexible starts, and protected deep-work blocks with fewer meetings by default.

02 / GROWTH

Learning budget

Annual budget for courses, books, events, software, and the odd tool that unlocks a new skill.

03 / REST

Real time off

Generous paid leave, studio shutdowns, and no heroic crunch disguised as passion.
